original_question: For the virtual braid group V B_n, determine whether it is linear for all n greater than 3, whether the representation rho: V B_n -> Aut(F_{n+1}) described in the paper is faithful for all n greater than 2, and whether there exist non-equivalent virtual links whose braid closures become equivalent after applying the welded-braid representation rho_A.
target_in_paper: Section 8.3, Questions from V. Bardakov, specifically items 1–3: the linearity of the virtual braid group VB_n, the faithfulness of the representation ρ: VB_n → Aut(F_{n+1}), and the comparison between virtual-link closures and welded-link closures via ρ_A. ([impan.pl](https://www.impan.pl/shop/en/publication/transaction/download/product/86155))
correct_elements: Your draft correctly identifies the three Bardakov problems in the right order and with the right quantifier thresholds: n > 3 for linearity of VB_n, n > 2 for faithfulness of ρ, and the existence question about non-equivalent virtual links whose braid representatives acquire equivalent welded closures after applying ρ_A. ([impan.pl](https://www.impan.pl/shop/en/publication/transaction/download/product/86155))
missing_details: To be stand-alone, the question should define VB_n as the group generated by σ_1, …, σ_{n-1} (the braid-group generators) and ρ_1, …, ρ_{n-1} (the symmetric-group generators), with mixed relations σ_iρ_{i+1}ρ_i = ρ_{i+1}ρ_iσ_{i+1} for 1 ≤ i ≤ n−2 and σ_iρ_j = ρ_jσ_i for |i−j| > 1. ([impan.pl](https://www.impan.pl/shop/en/publication/transaction/download/product/86155))

The paper explicitly defines “linear” here to mean: there exists an embedding of the group into GL_m(k) for some natural number m and some field k; your draft does not state that ambient target. ([impan.pl](https://www.impan.pl/shop/en/publication/transaction/download/product/86155))

The faithfulness part should include the paper’s exact data F_{n+1} = <x_1, x_2, …, x_n, y> and the concrete automorphisms defining ρ on σ_i and ρ_i; otherwise the question is not fully self-contained. ([impan.pl](https://www.impan.pl/shop/en/publication/transaction/download/product/86155))

The draft should also note the nearby paper-context that this ρ is presented as an extension of the faithful Artin representation ρ_A : B_n → Aut(F_n). ([impan.pl](https://www.impan.pl/shop/en/publication/transaction/download/product/86155))

In the third part, the paper asks about virtual links L_v and L'_v that are closures of virtual braids β_v ∈ VB_n and β'_v ∈ VB_m, and then asks whether the welded links represented by ρ_A(β_v) and ρ_A(β'_v) are equivalent as welded links; your wording compresses this braid-closure setup and makes “after applying ρ_A” slightly ambiguous. ([impan.pl](https://www.impan.pl/shop/en/publication/transaction/download/product/86155))

The paper presents these as three separate open questions inside Section 8.3 rather than as one already-packaged theorem or conjecture, so a faithful rewrite should preserve that three-part scope while still making the whole prompt read as one composite research question. ([impan.pl](https://www.impan.pl/shop/en/publication/transaction/download/product/86155))
refined_question: For the virtual braid group VB_n generated by σ_1, …, σ_{n-1} and ρ_1, …, ρ_{n-1}, where the σ_i generate the braid group B_n, the ρ_i generate the symmetric group S_n, and the mixed relations are σ_iρ_{i+1}ρ_i = ρ_{i+1}ρ_iσ_{i+1} for 1 ≤ i ≤ n−2 and σ_iρ_j = ρ_jσ_i for |i−j| > 1, determine whether the following three Bardakov problems have affirmative answers: (i) VB_n is linear for every n > 3, in the sense that VB_n embeds into GL_m(k) for some natural number m and some field k; (ii) the representation ρ : VB_n → Aut(F_{n+1}), where F_{n+1} = <x_1, …, x_n, y> and ρ is given by σ_i(x_i) = x_ix_{i+1}x_i^{-1}, σ_i(x_{i+1}) = x_i, σ_i(x_k) = x_k, σ_i(y) = y, and ρ_i(x_i) = yx_{i+1}y^{-1}, ρ_i(x_{i+1}) = y^{-1}x_i y, ρ_i(x_k) = x_k, ρ_i(y) = y for k ≠ i, i+1, is faithful for every n > 2; and (iii) there exist non-equivalent virtual links L_v and L'_v that are closures of virtual braids β_v ∈ VB_n and β'_v ∈ VB_m such that the welded links represented by ρ_A(β_v) and ρ_A(β'_v) are equivalent as welded links. ([impan.pl](https://www.impan.pl/shop/en/publication/transaction/download/product/86155))
justification: The nearest official target is not an introduction-level conjecture but the three consecutive open questions in Section 8.3 attributed to V. Bardakov. The nearby context there already fixes the presentation of VB_n, the meaning of linearity, the exact automorphisms defining ρ on F_{n+1}, and the braid-closure language used to compare virtual and welded links. Your draft is close, but it omits enough notation and setup that it is not yet fully stand-alone, especially in item (iii), where the paper phrases the problem through closures of specific virtual braids and equivalence of the resulting welded links. ([impan.pl](https://www.impan.pl/shop/en/publication/transaction/download/product/86155))
